verdict: Organic activity is your only live channel, and it is slowing.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google was inactive for the full 28-day period, so every engagement this period came from your Google Business Profile. That profile drove 93 total actions — 20 calls, 29 direction requests, and 44 website clicks — which is meaningful organic presence, but GBP activity dropped 40% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, with the final three days of the period recording zero actions. Instagram reach fell similarly, down 38% week-over-week. We are reviewing the GBP drop now to determine whether this is a seasonal dip or a visibility issue that needs a direct response, and paid channel activity is being re-examined so that organic is not carrying the full load going forward.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, directions, and website clicks combined
drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days
paid ad spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day window

watch_item.issue: GBP actions fell to zero for the last three days of the period, and 20 inbound calls this period are not appearing as tracked opportunities in the pipeline.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the GBP visibility drop this week and closing the gap between inbound calls and pipeline capture so that interest reaching you is not lost.
